description: A granular texturiser feeding a clock-synced crossfade delay, with a single-sideband frequency shifter in the feedback path

params.text: Sets how thickly the grains are launched and how far each is thrown from where it belongs: one every half window and no throw counter-clockwise, one every eighth and a 180ms throw clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the SCATTER input before it is added to the SCATTER knob
Picks the delay length as a note value of the beat, in nine steps from two whole notes at the counter-clockwise end down to a hundred-and-twenty-eighth note at the clockwise end
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the TIME input before it is added to the TIME knob
Shifts the delayed signal in frequency, marked minus 12 to plus 12 semitones but applied as a flat shift in hertz, the ends of the travel reaching the Max shift figure on the menu
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the SHIFT input before it is added to the SHIFT knob
Sets how much of the delay output goes back into it, none at the counter-clockwise end and 0.98 at the clockwise end
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the FEEDBACK input before it is added to the FEEDBACK knob
Crossfades the dry input against the granulated and delayed signal on an equal-power curve

inputs.text: The audio input into the granulator
A clock here sets the beat the delay's note value is measured against, taken from rising edges above 1V; with nothing patched the delay runs at the Base time on the menu instead
Moves the grain density and throw, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the SCATTER knob's travel
Moves the delay's note value, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the TIME knob's travel
Moves the frequency shift, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V moving it 12 semitones at the attenuverter's clockwise end
Moves the feedback amount, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the FEEDBACK knob's travel

outputs.text: The granulated and delayed signal mixed with the dry input, five times the internal signal level and clipped at 10V

menu: Grain size — sets how long each grain is, in milliseconds; the module starts at 50ms
Base time — sets the delay time used while no clock is patched to CLK; the module starts at 0.5 seconds
Crossfade — sets how long the delay takes to fade from its old length into a new one; the module starts at 20ms
Max shift — sets the frequency shift, in hertz, that the ends of the SHIFT knob's travel reach; the module starts at 1000Hz
